account: It is day 0, about 09:02. I came from home to town hall and read the secretary's appointment book. Today's business is morning correspondence, a 10:00 market walk in the plaza, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea with the neighbour at an east-bank dockside cottage at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I returned the appointment book to its chest. The secretary is nearby holding a writable book. I asked whether there was correspondence or urgent business, but have heard no reply yet. Townsfolk 04, 28, 08, and 06 have passed or stood near the plaza-side area; I have not spoken with them or learned what they are doing. Nothing I have actually seen establishes anything unusual happening today. The appointments appear to be ordinary municipal work and a social visit; I have no evidence of any other purpose or coordinated activity.
